title: Saudi-Led Coalition Warns Houthis Against Arms Smuggling, Reports Intercepting a Vessel
detail: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen warned the Houthis against smuggling weapons and said it had intercepted a vessel. Details on the vessel, cargo and location were not given in the feed; claims are coalition statements and unverified independently.

media.caption: Saudi-led coalition warns Houthis against arms smuggling

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Reports Intercepting Houthi Ballistic Missile Launched Toward Riyadh
detail: A Saudi-led coalition interception of a Houthi ballistic missile launched toward Riyadh was reported in a news-aggregator headline. Outlet, launch time, debris impact and any damage were not available in the feed; the claim is unverified pending primary confirmation.
